notes.title: Love In The TIme Of Corona
notes.content:
Hello Hiscorers!

It's a difficult time at the moment on this flat plane, so to help make it better for everyone I've decided to PERMANENTLY reduce the price of my ART. Do not thank me, your money is thanks enough.

(also you can now play the game in Chinese)

notes.title: Hiscores! Gold now has Chinese language support!
notes.content: I added Chinese language support! To Hiscores! Gold!

notes.title: Nominate Hiscores! Gold for Most Innovative Gameplay in the 2019 Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Name ONE release this year that has more innovative gameplay than Hiscores! Gold.

You can't, so nominate it right now.

notes.title: Hiscores! Gold: The T-Shirt is now available at a high price!
Hiscores! Gold: Halloween now live!
notes.content:
Oh no, the Evil Pumpkin Dropper has come to Hiscores! Gold Town and is dropping his dirty pumpkins all over your face.

Smash those pumpkins before they hit the ground OR SUFFER THE CONSEQUENCES.

notes.title: You HAVE found the secrets, right?
Hiscores! Gold now has achievements!
notes.content: That's it. That's the entire announcement.
